column1: # WC 2026 match schedule — venue table for the MatchContext venue contract.
# any row as authoritative until BOTH checks pass:
#   (a) src/check_schedule_venues.py cross-checks drafted venues against the
#       football-data.org venue fields at the next ROUTINE tracker refresh
#       (matches already played: all of the group stage
#   (b) manual fifa.com spot-check of the remaining unplayed fixtures
# Source: FIFA official match schedule (venue schedule released 2024-02-04;
# NOT from a repo artifact — which is exactly why the verification gates exist.
#   * confidence applies to venue_country — the only field inference consumes
#     (host advantage requires a host team playing in its own country).
#     stadium/venue_city are best-effort identifiers for the cross-check.
#   * BLANK venue_country = unknown: consumers MUST fall back to neutral for
#     that fixture and log the fallback (approved Checkpoint 2 semantics).
#     Blanks are deliberate — unverifiable recall was left empty
#   * The 9 host group rows have venue_country certain by construction: FIFA
#     guarantees hosts play their group matches in their own country.
#   * seq discriminates rows within a stage/matchday; it carries NO schedule
#     meaning (which of a group-matchday's two fixtures is seq 1 is arbitrary
#     and R32 seq is NOT the simulate.R32_SLOTS index — that mapping lands
#     with its own validation at the serving-rebuild phase).
#   * match_number: official numbering; only filled where certain. Ranges:
#   * verified: empty until a check passes; the cross-check script writes
